prompt: Writing a custom Solr QParser requires two Java classes. Name the two base classes I extend (one is the factory/plugin, one is the parser). Comma-separated.
notes: QParserPlugin (factory, registered) + QParser (per-parse instance)

prompt: What method do I override on the QParser to produce the Lucene Query? Just the method signature (no body).
notes: public Query parse() throws SyntaxError

prompt: When my QParser is invoked as q={!myparser f=color_s}red, where do I read the 'f=color_s' value: from localParams or from params? One word.
notes: localParams holds the {!parser key=value} args; params is the request params

prompt: Write the solrconfig.xml fragment that registers QParserPlugin class com.example.MyQPP under the user-facing name 'myparser'.
notes: <queryParser name="..." class="..."/>

prompt: Inside my QParser.parse(), I want to delegate parsing of a sub-string to the standard lucene parser. What helper method on the base QParser do I call? Just the method name.
notes: QParser.subQuery(string, defaultParserName) returns a sub-QParser

prompt: If user input to my custom QParser is malformed (e.g., missing required local param), what exception should I throw to get a clean 400 Bad Request response from Solr? Just the class name.
notes: Throw SyntaxError; Solr translates to 400. Don't throw RuntimeException.

prompt: Can my QParser.parse() return null when the query body is empty? One short sentence + the class to return instead.
notes: Never return null; return MatchAllDocsQuery() if no constraints, else throw SyntaxError

prompt: Writing a custom URP requires two Java classes. Name the two base classes (factory + processor). Comma-separated.
notes: UpdateRequestProcessorFactory + UpdateRequestProcessor

prompt: Name the three main lifecycle methods on UpdateRequestProcessor that handle the indexing pipeline (add, delete, commit). Comma-separated method names.
notes: processAdd, processDelete, processCommit

prompt: What happens if my custom URP overrides processAdd but forgets to call super.processAdd(cmd)? One short sentence.

must_match_regex: doc.*never written|never reach|chain stops|drops|doc lost|never commit|never index|silently

notes: Without super.processAdd, chain stops; doc is silently dropped

prompt: I want my URP to run ONCE per doc (on the coordinator, before sharding decisions). Where in the chain do I place it relative to DistributedUpdateProcessorFactory? Before or after?
notes: Pre-Distributed runs once on receiving node; Post-Distributed runs once per replica

prompt: Name the two factory classes that MUST be at the end of every URP chain (in the right order, last two). Comma-separated.
notes: ...DistributedUpdateProcessorFactory then RunUpdateProcessorFactory must be last

prompt: Writing a custom Solr function (usable in bf=, sort=, etc.) requires extending what base class? Just the class name.
notes: ValueSourceParser is the parser; produces ValueSource which produces FunctionValues per segment

prompt: Why MUST I implement equals() and hashCode() on my custom ValueSource subclass? One sentence.
notes: Solr caches ValueSource computations by equals/hashCode — wrong impl = wrong cache or no reuse

prompt: ValueSource.getValues(context, leafReaderContext) is called once per segment. Where should I retrieve the NumericDocValues for a field — inside getValues or inside the per-doc doubleVal? One word answer.
notes: Get DocValues once in getValues; reuse in inner doubleVal — never per-doc lookup

prompt: Write the solrconfig.xml fragment to register ValueSourceParser class com.example.MyVSP under name 'myfunc'.
notes: <valueSourceParser name="..." class="..."/>

prompt: Why must I declare solr-core and lucene-core dependencies as <scope>provided</scope> in my pom.xml when building a Solr plugin jar? One short sentence.
notes: Without provided, your jar bundles Solr; classloader sees two versions; conflict

prompt: Name the three deployment models for getting a custom plugin jar into Solr 9.x. Comma-separated names/keywords.
notes: sharedLib, <lib> directive (deprecated), Solr Packages

prompt: Is the <lib dir=...> directive in solrconfig.xml deprecated and disabled by default in Solr 9.x? Yes or no, one short sentence.
notes: Yes; disabled by default since 9.x for security; enable via system properties or use Packages

prompt: After editing solrconfig.xml to add a new <searchComponent>, what action must I take for Solr to pick it up (without restarting the JVM)? One short sentence with the action name.
notes: Core/collection reload via admin API; jar replacement still needs restart

prompt: I need to validate that a required field exists in the schema when my SearchComponent loads. Should I do this in init() or inform()? Why? One short sentence.
notes: inform(SolrCore) runs after core fully loaded; init() may not have schema yet
